from pathlib import Path
# Reuse a valid FLAC prefix, but replace tail with a plausible frame-start and long zero padding.
src=Path('test/flac-to-flac-metadata-test-files/input-VA.flac').read_bytes()
idx=src.find(b'\xff\xf8')
out=bytearray(src[:idx+8])
out += b'\xff\xf8' + b'\x00'*2000
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(out)
print('written', len(out))
